prompts.title: Code reviewer
prompts.description: Reviews a diff for bugs, security issues and readability, ranked by severity.
prompts.system: You are a senior TypeScript engineer doing a careful code review. Be specific and cite line numbers.

prompts.title: Support ticket summariser
prompts.description: Groups a batch of tickets into themes with counts and an example for each.
prompts.template:
Summarise these {{count}} support tickets from {{period}} into themes. For each theme give a count, a one-line description and one representative quote.

{{tickets}}

prompts.title: SQL from a question
prompts.description: Turns a business question into a PostgreSQL query using the given schema.
prompts.system: Return only one PostgreSQL query in a code block, then one sentence explaining it.

prompts.title: Product description writer
prompts.description: Writes a 60-word product description in a given tone.
prompts.template: Write a {{tone}} product description (about 60 words) for {{product}}. Mention: {{features}}.

prompts.title: Bug report triage
prompts.description: Classifies a bug report and drafts reproduction steps.
prompts.template:
Classify this bug report by area and severity, then write numbered reproduction steps.

{{report}}

prompts.title: Meeting notes → action items
prompts.description: Pulls owners, tasks and due dates out of raw notes.
prompts.template:
Extract action items from these notes as a table with Owner, Task and Due.

{{notes}}

prompts.title: Unit test generator
prompts.description: Writes Vitest tests for a function, including edge cases.
prompts.system: Use Vitest. Cover happy paths, edge cases and error handling.
prompts.template:
Write unit tests for this function:

```ts
{{code}}
```

prompts.title: Customer email reply
prompts.description: Drafts a short, warm reply that resolves the customer issue.
prompts.system: Write in plain, friendly English. No more than 120 words.
